grh_5f33ed4eff247f170ffa.title: Miss Grant Takes Richmond
paragraphs: Inexperienced secretary Ellen Grant is hired by Dick Richmond's real-estate office without realizing that the business is largely a respectable front for illegal bookmaking. Taking the company at face value, Ellen enthusiastically proposes an affordable housing development and is put in charge, forcing Richmond and his partners to turn their fake operation into a real construction project to protect their cover. Her chaotic management creates comic disasters, but the houses become genuine and worthwhile. Ellen's faith in Richmond pushes him away from the racket, and the scheme that began as camouflage ends by giving him a legitimate business and a romance with the secretary who accidentally reformed it.

grh_5f453ca06e365cdbf5b0.title: Der Fuehrer
paragraphs: A dramatization based on Conrad Heiden's Der Fuehrer traces the fabrication and political use of the anti-Semitic Protocols of the Elders of Zion. The program follows the forged document from Russian secret-police manipulation through pogrom propaganda and into Nazi ideology, showing how false conspiracy claims were repurposed to divide populations, justify persecution and offer a political blueprint to Hitler and his followers. It closes by identifying the forgery as a deliberate lie whose spread helped prepare the ground for mass violence against Jews and other minorities.
